# Pull request stage

Use this guide when preparing, publishing, updating, or closing a pull request for repository work.

Before publication, confirm the intended branch and worktree, review the final diff, and gather the checks required by the repository. Describe what changed, why, and what evidence supports it. Keep the pull request draft until the agreed review and gate conditions are met. After review feedback, make focused corrections and update the evidence. Treat merge state and worktree cleanup as separate actions that require their own proof and custody rules.

The stage is complete when the pull request has an accurate disposition, required review and validation are satisfied or clearly pending, and related repository artifacts have an explicit next state.
